children: Breeze Acquisition Corp. II reported a net loss of $(138,206) for the first quarter of 2026, with basic and diluted loss per ordinary share of $(0.03). The company remains a blank-check special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) following its May 14, 2026 initial public offering, with proceeds placed in trust to fund a future business combination.
Diluted EPS: $(0.03) for Q1 2026 (basic and diluted loss per ordinary share).
IPO Completion: Completed initial public offering on May 14, 2026; proceeds placed in trust to support a future business combination.
Operational Status: Continues to operate as a blank-check SPAC with no operations or revenues; primary activities were IPO-related, formation and due diligence.
Use of Proceeds & Trust: Net proceeds and interest held in trust to finance an initial business combination and provide related working capital for a target company.
Capital Raising Milestone: Executed a private placement and partial over-allotment, establishing resources and registration rights to support future transactions.
